summary.en: After the recording at the Ishinomaki Yaiba Hall, the Detective Boys, Conan, Haibara, Ran, and Kogoro are taken on a tour of the city. During that time, Conan and Haibara notice Chiba scanning QR codes with a serious expression. The next morning, while the group is waiting for Kanehara, Ayumi realizes that she had left her script in her room, so she has to go back for it. However, she becomes curious when she sees Chiba following a man, so she follows Chiba but the two end up being subdued by him and his accomplice. Location: Underground parking of hotel building Victims: Kazunobu Chiba and Ayumi Yoshida Age: 24 years old (Chiba) and 7 years old (Ayumi) Method: Shocking (Chiba), Unknown (Ayumi) Culprits: Dario and an unknown person Worried about why Ayumi is taking so long, Conan and Haibara begin investigating her whereabouts. In the process, someone told Haibara that they saw someone looking like Detective Chiba. Conan uses the name of Sleeping Kogoro to ask Takagi why Chiba is here. Takagi then tells Conan about an unsolved smuggling case, which shares the same culprit to the recently-reported murder. Smuggling and murder? Time: Recent years (smuggling) Stolen items: Rare goods of high value Takagi told Conan about the unsolved smuggling case involving the murder occurred recently. Mitsuhiko and Genta have sneaked out to investigate Ayumi's whereabouts, and the duo happen to meet Conan and Haibara, who have been doing the same. Upon learning that Ayumi is in some kind of danger, the four of them split up to scan the QR codes, since Chiba himself had also scanned the QR codes yesterday for peculiar circumstances. Just when the four are starting to get tired after finding some abnormalities with the two specific QR codes, Motomura happens to pass by and is asked by the kids to help with this tricky situation. They eventually are able to track the whereabouts of Ayumi, and Chiba, but will they be able to save them?
